blocks.text: Los Angeles, United States—A pianist working on a cruise ship was rescued by two fishermen after drifting for nine hours in the Pacific Ocean about 30 kilometers (20 miles) off the coast of California, US media reported. The circumstances under which the 37-year-old man fell overboard from the “Ovation of the Seas,” a Royal Caribbean ship bound for Mexico, are unknown, CBS News reported. The man, whose identity wasn’t released, was hospitalized and is not in a life-threatening condition, according to the US Coast Guard.
